mapper.select: SELECT v.id AS version_id, v.agreement_version, v.content, v.content_sha256, a.content_sha256 AS accepted_content_sha256, a.accepted_at FROM merchant_agreement_acceptance a INNER JOIN merchant_agreement_version v ON v.id = a.agreement_version_id WHERE a.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY a.id ASC LIMIT 2

SELECT v.id AS version_id, v.agreement_version, v.content, v.content_sha256, a.content_sha256 AS accepted_content_sha256, a.accepted_at FROM merchant_agreement_acceptance a INNER JOIN merchant_agreement_version v ON v.id = a.agreement_version_id WHERE a.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY a.id ASC LIMIT 2 FOR UPDATE

SELECT v.id AS version_id, v.agreement_version, v.content, v.content_sha256 FROM merchant_agreement_current c INNER JOIN merchant_agreement_version v ON v.id = c.agreement_version_id WHERE c.agreement_key = 'MERCHANT'

SELECT v.id AS version_id, v.agreement_version, v.content, v.content_sha256 FROM merchant_agreement_current c INNER JOIN merchant_agreement_version v ON v.id = c.agreement_version_id WHERE c.agreement_key = 'MERCHANT' FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,canonical_version,params_sha256,params_canonical,status,receipt_json FROM merchant_command_idempotency WHERE request_key = #{requestKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_command_idempotency SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', receipt_json = #{receiptJson}, succeeded_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE request_key = #{requestKey} AND status = 'RESERVED'
